404.description: The page you were looking for could not be found. Head back to BasicSwap DEX to swap cryptocurrencies peer-to-peer with atomic swaps.

about.title: About BasicSwap - Ten years of cypherpunk infrastructure
about.description: BasicSwap is a decentralized messaging protocol for cross-chain atomic swaps, built in the open by a community with a decade of cypherpunk work behind it.
about.socialDescription: A decentralized messaging protocol for cross-chain atomic swaps, built by an open community on cypherpunk foundations a decade in the making.

bitcoin-to-monero.title: BTC to XMR atomic swap - Bitcoin to Monero, no custodian
bitcoin-to-monero.description: Swap BTC for XMR on chain, in either direction. Adaptor signatures bind the two payments together, so no bridge, wrapped token or custodian holds the coins.

desktop.title: BasicSwap Desktop - Self-hosted atomic swaps, 12 coins
desktop.description: Run a local node and settle atomic swaps across 12 chains, Bitcoin and Monero included. Post offers, provide liquidity, hold your own keys. Open source.

donations.title: Donate to BasicSwap - Fund the Open-Source Atomic Swap DEX
donations.description: BasicSwap is funded by its community, with no protocol fees and no investors. If it saved you money or kept your keys in your hands, here's how to give back.
donations.socialDescription: BasicSwap is community-funded. No protocol fees, no investors. Support the project in the coins it helps you trade.

faq.title: FAQ - Atomic swaps, supported coins, fees, and security
faq.description: How BasicSwap works, which coins you can trade, what a swap costs, how long one takes, and what happens if a swap fails.

index.title: BasicSwap DEX - Atomic swaps for Bitcoin, Monero and 10 more
index.description: Swap Bitcoin, Monero, and 10 more coins peer-to-peer. You meet other traders and settle atomic swaps directly. No custodian, no account, no protocol fee.
index.ogImageAlt: BasicSwap Desktop showing the distributed network order book

links.title: BasicSwap Links - Website, Markets, Docs, Socials and Chat
links.description: All the official BasicSwap DEX links in one place: website, markets, X, YouTube, documentation, community chat, and ways to support development.

mobile.title: BasicSwap Mobile - Cross-chain atomic swaps from your phone
mobile.description: Swap crypto across chains from wallet apps you already use. There's no blockchain to sync and no account to create, and your keys stay on your phone throughout.

protocol.title: Protocol - How atomic swaps settle without a coordinator
protocol.description: Adaptor signatures, secure peer messaging, and light node lookups. The three primitives that settle a cross-chain swap atomically, with no central matcher.
protocol.socialDescription: Adaptor signatures, secure peer messaging, and lightweight Electrum-node lookups. The three primitives behind every BasicSwap atomic swap.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions - BasicSwap Atomic Swap DEX
terms.description: The terms for using BasicSwap, a decentralized messaging protocol for cross-chain atomic swaps that is open source, non-custodial and has no central operator.
terms.socialDescription: The legal terms governing your use of BasicSwap. Open source, non-custodial, no central operator.

web.title: BasicSwap Web - Cross-chain atomic swaps in your browser
web.description: Coming soon: swap crypto across chains from a browser tab, in the websites and web wallets you already use, with nothing to install and your keys kept with you.
